Motion capture games · 10 November 2026 · English

Camera first.
Left feels like left.

Mole Motion and Dodgeball now open in Camera mode, with connected-device discovery ready for an explicit Start camera action.

Issue #32 · Pull request

What changed and why

Both games previously selected rehearsal on load. Camera is now the first/default option, device metadata loads immediately, and camera setup is visible. Rehearsal remains one selection away. Page load enumerates metadata without acquiring camera capture, opening a camera stream or consuming round time.

The existing camera, pointer and arrow-key direction mapping was already correct. This change preserves that mapping, documents it explicitly and adds regression checks. Mole targets now use the same mapJoint helper as contacts, so target placement follows the shared contain-fit mirror transform. The stage explains “Move left → go left.” No wire schema, inference provider, collision rule, buffering limit or independently distributable package changes.

Facing the display, your left is left on screen. Physical movement toward the participant’s left increases canonical, unmirrored camera x. The presentation mirror maps this with 1 - x, decreasing displayed x. Pointer input performs the inverse mapping; the left arrow increases canonical x. Anatomical joint names remain stable.

Before and after

All imagery and observations are synthetic. The magenta rectangle is a generated camera marker for orientation checks, not participant footage or an inferred person. Screenshots below embed their original image bytes and work offline.

Limits and follow-through

No physical camera, participant movement, camera-driver release, mounting orientation, model accuracy or motion-to-display latency was tested in this change. Hardware trials must verify that each installation supplies the documented upright, unmirrored canonical image. Existing freshness, identity, camera-release and scoring rules remain in force. Camera Push still needs calibrated depth. The component/build table remains current: source-only modules are checked through the existing Vite application and no new package was introduced.

Baseline screenshots use main 15a56dc. The camera-default change preserves existing interaction modes and retains anatomical names without introducing another input mirror.
